why_the_score_is_what_it_is: Free cash flow margin reads 67.19 %, which scores 97 out of 100.
Three year revenue CAGR reads 19.8 %, which scores 91 out of 100.
Net debt to EBITDA reads 0.94 x, which scores 81 out of 100.
what_could_go_wrong: Return on invested capital reads 2.49 %, scoring 22.
Competitive advantage scores only 20 out of 100.
why_laura_should_care: This belongs to growth capital, not to the money dedicated to the ten fixed payments.
Her mandatory payments are protected by dated instruments elsewhere in the portfolio.
Modelled funding probability is 99.9% against the team's 95% floor, so this position does not weaken funding certainty.

review_triggers: Modelled operating funding probability falls below 95%.
Laura's stated objectives or the residency timeline change.
The earnings thesis breaks, or free cash flow deteriorates for two consecutive filings.
Net leverage rises materially above the level recorded at purchase.
Valuation moves above the top of its own five year range without an earnings justification.
